summary: Braskem S.A. files a 6-K responding to a CVM inquiry regarding a news report that it may default on USD 150 million bond interest payments due July 2026 and is considering an out-of-court restructuring. The company confirms it engaged advisors in September 2025 to assess capital structure alternatives and is in discussions with creditor advisors, considering debt rescheduling or creditor protection mechanisms. No formal decision has been made. The filing does not specify terms, premiums, or advisors by name. Watch for creditor negotiations, potential acceleration triggers, and whether Braskem avoids judicial reorganization.
